title: Apex of the Myriad Demons
next_chapter_hook: The Demonic Path Commander raised his hand gently, and a fragmentary scene materialized in the void—a sacrificial altar from ten thousand years ago, where two identical figures were forcibly torn apart by the Heavenly Eye, their blood dyeing the entire firmament crimson.

text.content: A blood moon hung above the firmament, dyeing the Kunlun peak into an eerie scarlet. Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, his black robe billowing in the mountain wind. That deep, echoing voice from across ten thousand years still reverberated in his ears. 'You have finally arrived, child of the Chen family'—these words struck like a blade directly into the depths of his soul. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve grew faintly warm, as if sensing some familiar aura. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, gazing at the surging demonic energy deep within the peak. An inexplicable thrill coursed through his heart. He knew that tonight, the gears of destiny would turn once more.

Demonic energy churned atop the peak like ink-dark clouds pressing down. A figure slowly rose from the abyss. Clad in jet-black battle armor, wreathed in blood-colored lightning, his aura was so overwhelming it seemed capable of tearing heaven and earth apart. Yet when that face was fully revealed beneath the blood moon, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—that face was identical to his own! The brows, the eyes, the curve of the lips, even the faint scar at the left eyebrow's tip—all matched like a mirror image. The only difference was that this person's pupils were a deep, blood-red, revealing endless vicissitudes and madness.

Chen Ji instinctively stepped back half a pace, his fingertips already touching the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. His breath quickened, his heart hammered like war drums. The commander of the Demonic Path at the Apex of Ten Thousand Demons actually shared his exact face? At this moment, countless possibilities flashed through his mind—bloodline secret arts? Soul-seizing avatar? Or... some deeper connection? The Tianji Record suddenly vibrated intensely, and a line of golden text appeared on the fragment: 'The threads of destiny resonate; blood of the same origin shall not harm each other.' Chen Ji stared at those words, his heart surging with tumultuous waves. Blood of the same origin? What did that mean?

dialogue.content: (Inner turmoil suppressed with effort, speaking coldly) Who exactly are you? Why... why do you have this face?

text.content: At this moment, the world suddenly changed color. The blood moon erupted with dazzling light, and two invisible threads shot simultaneously from Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander's chests, colliding violently in the void! Those threads were brilliant as the Milky Way, entwined with the aura of destiny. Where they passed, space twisted and rules collapsed. Boulders on the Kunlun peak floated skyward,疯狂 rotating around the two figures. Wind howled, demonic energy and spiritual energy colliding to create sparks of thunder across the heavens. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest, as if something was awakening within him, preparing to break free.

The Demonic Path Commander stepped forward, a complex emotion flickering in his blood-red eyes—joy, pain, and a yearning suppressed for ten thousand years. Gazing at Chen Ji bound by the threads of destiny, his lips slowly curved into a bitter smile. 'Child of the Chen family...' His voice was low and hoarse, carrying boundless weariness. 'No, I should say, my other half. We... have finally met.' The moment his words fell, the threads of destiny shook violently once more. A terrifying bolt of lightning struck down, illuminating the entire peak as bright as daylight.

dialogue.content: (Enduring the sharp pain in his chest, eyes sharp as knives) The other half? I don't understand what you're saying. You'd better explain clearly, otherwise—

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander actually laughed upon hearing this. That laughter echoed across the peak, carrying an indescribable sorrow and madness. 'Otherwise what? Kill me?' He spread his arms wide, allowing demonic energy to surge肆意 over his form. 'You and I are beings of the same origin. The moment you kill me, you will also die. This is a curse亲手刻下 by the Heavenly Eye—ten thousand years ago, it forcibly separated us, planting this shackle that forbids us from harming each other for eternity, yet also forbids us from reuniting.' He stepped closer, blood-red eyes gazing directly at Chen Ji. 'But tonight, with the blood moon descending, the time has come.'

choice.prompt: Faced with this Demonic Path Commander who shared his face, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Directly question the other's relationship to you, and why the Heavenly Eye separated you. Display the protagonist's composure and sharpness.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may withdraw goodwill

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh, not retreating but advancing instead, meeting the Demonic Path Commander's gaze. 'Since you claim we are beings of the same origin, then I ask you—what happened ten thousand years ago? Why did the Heavenly Eye separate us? What is the relationship between you and me?' His voice was like cold ice, each word a question. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve grew faintly warm, as if reminding him to stay vigilant.

choices.description: Suppress doubts and listen to what the other has to say first. Display the protagonist's restraint and calculation, gathering intelligence before making judgments.
choices.visible_reward: The other party may reveal more secrets

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his doubts within. He knew that since this person dared to reveal his true face, they must have something to rely on. Rather than questioning rashly and startling the prey, it was better to listen first. Thus he stood with hands clasped behind his back, expressionless, gazing calmly at the other party. 'Speak then. I'm listening.' His voice was terrifyingly calm, as if awaiting a verdict long since fated.

dialogue.content: (Eyes flickering slightly, lips curving into a sardonic arc) Beings of the same origin? A curse from the Heavenly Eye? Sounds like quite the well-crafted story. However... I'd like to see what other tricks you have up your sleeve.

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander showed no anger; instead, a meaningful smile spread across his face. 'Story?' He slowly shook his head. 'No, Chen Ji, this is all true. Ten thousand years ago, we were originally the same soul, the same existence. The Heavenly Eye feared our power, so it devised a vicious scheme, forcibly tearing us apart into two halves. One half remained in the mortal realm, bearing heavenly fate and fortune; the other half was cast into the Demonic Path, enduring eternal curses and solitude.' He raised his hand, pointing to his own heart. 'And your Tianji Record Fragment is precisely one of the chains that once sealed our power.'

dialogue.content: (Narrowing his eyes, inner alarm bells ringing) Then what about these threads of destiny? Why do they resonate so intensely when the two of us meet?

text.content: The threads of destiny intertwined madly in the air, emitting a piercing hum. The Demonic Path Commander gazed at that brilliant thread, a trace of reminiscence flickering in his eyes. 'Because we were originally one.' His voice was low and solemn. 'This thread is the bond of our souls. For ten thousand years, it has slumbered within each of us, only awakening when two people reunite at close enough distance. And the stronger its resonance, the closer... the day we can reunite as one approaches.' He paused, blood-red eyes blazing with manic fire. 'Chen Ji, are you willing? Willing to reunite with me and reclaim the power that should have been ours?'

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander proposed reuniting as one, and Chen Ji faces the ultimate choice of destiny:

choices.description: Refuse this mad proposal, unshakable regardless of what the other says. Display the protagonist's independent will.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may take extreme measures

text.content: Chen Ji laughed coldly, that laughter echoing across the peak, carrying undisguised mockery. 'Reunite as one?' He stepped forward, standing in direct confrontation with the Demonic Path Commander. 'Setting aside whether your words are true or false—even if you spoke the truth—why should I trust a person of the Demonic Path? Why should I surrender myself to an existence unseen for ten thousand years?' He pointed to his own chest. 'Chen Ji is Chen Ji, not some existence's half!' The moment his words fell, the threads of destiny trembled violently, as if mourning this rupture.

choices.description: Neither refuse nor agree; first probe how many trump cards the other party still holds. Display the protagonist's guile and caution.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may lose patience
choices.process_label: 考虑合二为一的可能性

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately; instead, he stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing deeply at the other party. 'What you say requires time for verification.' His voice was calm as still water, devoid of any emotional fluctuation. 'The events of ten thousand years ago are too distant. Relying solely on your words, I cannot judge truth from falsehood.' He paused, shifting his tone. 'However... if you can provide more evidence to convince me that what you speak is not lies, perhaps I will seriously consider your proposal.'

dialogue.content: (Silence for a moment, then speaking softly) Evidence? You claim we are beings of the same origin, that the Heavenly Eye separated us—isn't there supposed to be evidence for all this? Empty words—how can I trust you?

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander's eyes flickered with a trace of appreciation upon hearing this. 'Good, truly worthy of my—no, of the one I chose.' He drew from his chest a pitch-black token, upon which was carved an ancient rune, identical to the birthmark on Chen Ji's chest. 'This is the Separation Token亲手刻下 by the Heavenly Eye ten thousand years ago, and also the finest proof of our shared origin.' He tossed the token to Chen Ji. 'Take it, and you will witness—the very night ten thousand years ago, when we were torn apart.' The token traced a black arc through the air. Chen Ji下意识 reached out to catch it. The moment his fingertips touched the token, a mighty flood of memories instantly surged into his mind.

Scenes flickered. Chen Ji seemed to have fallen into the river of time. He saw—the sacrificial altar of ten thousand years ago, two identical figures standing back-to-back. Around them were countless golden chains and blood-red lightning. A massive vertical eye hung above the firmament—that was the Heavenly Eye! It let out a deafening roar: 'Your power is too great, threatening the运转 of Heaven's Way. Today, I shall completely separate you, forbidden to harm each other for eternity!' Before its words even finished, a brilliant sword-light descended from the Nine Heavens, hacking the two figures asunder. Blood gushed forth, dyeing the entire altar crimson. The two separated souls let out heartrending screams of agony, their pain so intense it nearly shattered their spirits...

The vision dissolved. Chen Ji forcefully opened his eyes, discovering himself still standing on the Kunlun peak, clutching the Separation Token tightly in his hand. His forehead was covered in cold sweat, his breath ragged as bellows. That memory had been too real—so real he could almost feel the excruciating agony of his soul being hacked apart when that sword-light descended. 'This...' He opened his mouth, yet found himself unable to speak. The Demonic Path Commander watched him quietly, blood-red eyes filled with complex emotions. 'Now, do you believe?' His voice was low and weary. 'We were originally one, yet forcibly torn apart by the Heavenly Eye. For ten thousand years, I have struggled bitterly within the Demonic Path, solely waiting for this day—to reunite with you, to find a way to become one again.'

choice.prompt: Having witnessed the brutal separation of ten thousand years ago with his own eyes, Chen Ji must make a final response:

choices.description: Believe the other's words, and begin to seriously consider the possibility of reuniting as one. Display the protagonist's determination to accept destiny.
choices.risk_hint: May fall into the other's scheme

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, slowly closing his eyes. When he opened them again, the doubt and vigilance within his gaze had already faded, replaced by a complex sense of release. 'If all of this is true...' He murmured softly. 'Then we are indeed victims of persecution by the Heavenly Eye, beings of the same origin.' He raised his head, gazing directly into the Demonic Path Commander's eyes. 'But the matter of reuniting as one is too significant. I need time to consider. Tonight, let us first... as brothers, get to know each other anew.' The moment his words fell, the threads of destiny seemed to sense something, emitting a long, melodious hum, their glow becoming softer.

choices.description: Even after seeing the evidence, still not blindly trust the other party. Display the protagonist's caution and cunning, secretly seeking weaknesses.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may be dissatisfied

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Separation Token into his sleeve, his expression revealing nothing, yet his heart was already surging with tremendous waves. That memory was indeed shocking, but was Chen Ji a person who easily trusted others? Apex of the Myriad Demons, Demonic Path Commander—who knew if this was yet another trap? He nodded slightly, his tone placid: 'The memory is indeed staggering, but with only these, I still cannot fully believe you.' He paused, shifting his tone. 'However, given that we share the same face, tonight I am willing to talk with you. As for cooperation... we shall speak another day.' A meaningful smile curved his lips.

dialogue.content: (Gripping the Separation Token tightly, a barely perceptible gleam flickering in his eyes) Even if it were true, so what? The 'us' of ten thousand years ago died on the sacrificial altar long ago. The current me is Chen Ji—a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect, a descendant of the Chen family. I will not deny my present self because of a fragmentary memory.

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander was stunned upon hearing this, then burst into laughter toward the sky. That laughter carried admiration, helplessness, and an inexpressible sorrow. 'Good, good, a true Chen Ji!' He ceased laughing, blood-red eyes blazing with strange light. 'Truly worthy of the existence sharing origin with me—this independence and pride has not changed in the slightest.' He turned to gaze upon the vast, desolate land beneath the blood moon, his voice becoming low and solemn. 'Since you are unwilling to reunite for now, I will not force you. But there is one thing you must know—the Heavenly Eye has already sensed the signs of our reunion. It will not sit by idly. Very soon, an even greater storm will descend. At that time, you and I must join forces if we are to have even a sliver of a chance.' The moment his words fell, the blood moon shuddered violently. A soundless thunder rolled through heaven and earth, as if some terrifying existence was gazing in this direction.

Chen Ji raised his head to gaze at the firmament. He could sense that the pressure of that invisible gaze was intensifying. The Heavenly Eye—that terrifying existence that had used generations of prophets as chess pieces, had now turned its attention toward him. 'It seems our time is running out.' He murmured softly, tucking the Separation Token into his sleeve alongside the Tianji Record Fragment. The moment the two objects touched, a faint glimmer flashed, as if some resonance had been created. The Demonic Path Commander observed this scene, a flash of joy flickering in his eyes, but quickly concealed it. 'Tonight, let us end here.' He stepped back, his form gradually dissolving. 'In three days, at the Abyss of Shadows, I will send someone to await you there. At that time, I will tell you more secrets regarding the Heavenly Eye, and... what kind of power we can truly obtain after reuniting.'

dialogue.content: (Gazing at the Dissolving figure of the Demonic Path Commander, eyes profound and deep) Three days... Abyss of Shadows... (Murmuring to himself) Whether friend or foe, this game has at least gained a few more variables. Heavenly Eye, just how many secrets are you still hiding?

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander's form completely dissolved into the demonic energy. Kunlun peak returned to silence. The blood moon still hung high, but the suffocating oppression had diminished considerably. Chen Ji stood alone at the cliff's edge, allowing the mountain wind to buffet his robe. His mind kept replaying everything that had just transpired—the face identical to his own, the resonance of the threads of destiny, that memory of being forcibly torn apart, and that terrifying truth: he was an existence carved apart by the Heavenly Eye, sharing origin with the Demonic Path Commander. 'Heh...' He laughed softly, that smile carrying an indescribable complexity. 'This is getting more and more interesting.' He turned to gaze toward the mountain's base, where the Tianqing Sect's lights twinkled. A trace of tenderness flickered in his eyes—that was contemplation regarding Su Qingyao, regarding Ling Yuan, regarding those unresolved mysteries. The encounter at the Apex of the Myriad Demons had concluded, but the chess game of destiny had just entered a new chapter.
